item.title: Batch Recruitment (5 Positions): Intern Partnership, Advocacy and Communication (PAC), Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, Bertoua and Maroua, Cameroon, WCAR, (6months)
item.description: UNICEF Cameroon is seeking motivated interns in Journalism, Communication, or related fields to support its Partnership, Advocacy and Communication (PAC) Section. The internship offers hands-on experience in media monitoring, audiovisual production, digital content creation, storytelling, advocacy, and private-sector partnerships. Ideal candidates are recent graduates or currently enrolled students with strong communication skills, an interest in humanitarian and development work, knowledge of audiovisual production, and a commitment to promoting children's rights, peace, and sustainable development in a multicultural environment.

item.title: Digital Impact Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kampala, Uganda, #00051311
item.description: Lead digital innovation. Strengthen systems. Transform outcomes for children.UNICEF Uganda is seeking a visionary Digital Impact Manager to lead innovation and digital transformation across programme and operations. You will harness technology, data and strategic partnerships to scale effective solutions, strengthen national systems, enhance organizational effectiveness and accelerate sustainable results for children.Ready to turn digital ambition into lasting impact? Join UNICEF Uganda and help reimagine what is possible for every child. Apply now.

item.title: Public Partnerships Specialist (P-3), Fixed Term Position, #00117185, Public Partnerships and Resource Mobilization Division, Washington DC, USA
item.description: The Partnerships Specialist contributes to strengthening UNICEF's strategic positioning with IFIs by monitoring institutional and political developments, identifying opportunities for policy influence, resource mobilization, and strategic collaboration, and supporting high-level engagement with senior partner counterparts. The position provides strategic analysis, partnership guidance, and coordination across the organization to ensure coherent and effective engagement with IFIs. The incumbent serves as a resource for colleagues on IFI-related partnership opportunities and contributes to positioning UNICEF as a trusted partner in advancing sustainable development outcomes for children.

item.title: Chief of Communication (P-4), TA (6 months), #138533, Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire - WCAR
item.description: Are you a seasoned Communication professional/expert looking to make a meaningful impact within a short period? UNICEF Cote d'Ivoire is hiring a Chief of Communication lead its Communication Section for 6 months. In this key role, you will be responsible for a range of tasks and deliver impactful results in the following area within your scope of work: Communication Strategy, Media Relations, Networking and partnerships, Celebrities and special events, Global Priorities and Campaigns, Resource Mobilization support, Management, Monitoring and Evaluation, Capacity Building and support. If you are a team player with excellent communication skills and expertise and have a passion for UNICEF's work, we invite you to apply for this challenging and rewarding role

item.title: Operations Manager, P-3, TA (364 days), #138626, Lagos - Nigeria, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Nigeria is seeking for an Operations Manager who will be accountable for operations functions, facilitate change, provide risk informed, solution-focused analysis, advice and services and contribute to programme and management decisions for delivering results for children in specific operational contexts.

item.title: Nutrition Specialist, P-3, TA (364 days), #00131951, Gaza, State of Palestine - MENA
item.description: Under the direct supervision of the Nutrition Manager, Gaza, the Nutrition Specialist will provide technical, operational and coordination support for the design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of UNICEF-supported nutrition programmes across Gaza. You will lead and support key strategic areas including: Emergency nutrition response, Nutrition in Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICU), Adolescent nutrition and Children Over Five Agenda, Community Feedback Mechanisms (CFM) and Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP)Management and oversight of H&N extenders supporting nutrition activities, Nutrition information management, analysis and visualization through Power BI, development of knowledge management products, Partner management, programme monitoring, reporting and donor accountability, OIC for the Nutrition Manager when required. You will contribute to maintaining UNICEF's commitments under the Core Commitments for Children (CCC) in Humanitarian Action while supporting recovery and resilience-building interventions.

item.title: Data Scientist, Emergency and Climate Change, APRO, Bangkok,Remotely with Travel to Malaysia, 5.56Months, (Open to International Candidates Only) Req#595827
item.description: The core objective of this assignment is to co-create or lead on data projects, support capacity building where applicable and developing data & analytics products, primarily using cutting-edge data and data science models to support horizontal initiatives across UNICEF’s core programmes on health, education, WASH and country climate initiatives and in particular the Automated SitRep, a tool that supports the Office of Emergency Programmes with data to support regional and country based emergencies and the Air Quality Model creation for Malaysia.

item.title: Contracts Specialist, P-3, TA (6 months), #137585, Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo - WCAR
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is responding to its 17th Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak, confirmed in May 2026 and affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The situation remains complex and evolving, with transmission occurring in both community and health-care settings. Response efforts are led by national authorities in a context shaped by health system limitations, logistical constraints, insecurity, displacement, and diverse community perceptions influencing health-seeking behaviors. UNICEF supports the Government through a multi-sectoral approach, focusing on community engagement, surveillance, infection prevention, and the continuity of essential services for vulnerable populations. This context requires strong coordination, adaptability, and cultural sensitivity to support effective and equitable response efforts, particularly for children and at-risk communities.

item.title: Immunization Specialist (P-3), TA, #00138528, Lusaka - Zambia, ESAR
item.description: The Immunization Specialist (Vaccine and Cold Chain Management) will help ensure that every child and woman has equitable access to life-saving vaccines by strengthening vaccine supply chains, cold chain systems, and immunization programme performance. Through technical support, capacity building, and data-driven planning, the position will contribute to increasing immunization coverage, reducing vaccine-preventable diseases, and reaching underserved and hard-to-reach communities across Zambia.

item.title: WASH Specialist (P-3), TA, (364 days), #00138507, Kampala - Uganda, ESAR
item.description: Turn your expertise into impact that lasts. Join our vibrant and dedicated team of professionals in UNICEF Uganda to shape climate-resilient and inclusive WASH solutions, strengthen national systems and strategic partnerships, and deliver sustainable results for children and communities. This is an opportunity to bring global expertise to a dynamic development and humanitarian context, influence change at scale, and build a healthier, more resilient future.Bring your expertise. Transform systems. Change lives. Apply now.

item.title: Partnerships Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, #00138472, Pacific Office, Suva, Fiji, APR

Working with governments, donors, UN agencies, NGOs, and other stakeholders, you will support partnership development, resource mobilization, advocacy, and knowledge sharing while contributing to collaborative solutions that deliver lasting impact for children throughout the region.

item.title: Chief (Professional Practices), P-5, Fixed Term, #00114284, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, NYHQ
item.description: Join UNICEF as Chief (Professional Practices), Internal Audit. Lead the strategy, quality, innovation, and transformation of UNICEF’s global internal audit function, driving risk-based assurance, audit excellence, and data-driven insights across a complex international organization. This senior leadership role is ideal for a seasoned audit professional with extensive experience in internal audit, risk management, quality assurance, and audit modernization who is passionate about strengthening governance and organizational impact.

item.title: People and Culture Manager, P-4, FT, #052227 Bamako, Mali-WCAR
item.description: Are you a strategic, solutions-oriented People and Culture professional ready to help shape a high-performing, inclusive and resilient workforce in a complex operating environment? UNICEF Mali is looking for a People and Culture Manager, P-4, to provide authoritative HR leadership, trusted advisory support and practical people solutions that enable the Country Office to deliver results for children across Mali. Reporting directly to the Country Representative, you will partner with senior management and programme leaders to align people strategies with country priorities; strengthen workforce planning, talent, performance, learning and organizational design; and promote a workplace culture grounded in UNICEF’s values of care, respect, integrity, trust, accountability and sustainability.

item.title: Humanitarian Policy Specialist (Children and Armed Conflict), P-3, Fixed Term Position, #00103042, Office of Emergency Programme, New York, the USA
item.description: UNICEF’s Office of Emergency Programmes (EMOPS) is seeking a highly qualified and experienced professional to join its Humanitarian Policy Section (HPS), Protection Team, as Humanitarian Policy Specialist – Children and Armed Conflict (CAAC), based in New York. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to UNICEF’s global work to protect children affected by armed conflict, helping to shape policy and advocacy and advance UNICEF’s engagement on the CAAC agenda. The role requires strong technical and strategic expertise, sound judgement, and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and partners across UNICEF and the wider UN system. If you are passionate about advancing the protection of children in armed conflict and ready to contribute to this critical area of UNICEF’s humanitarian work, we encourage you to apply.

item.title: Senior Adviser Education (Education in Emergencies) (P-5), Fixed-Term, #00133273, Global Programme Division, COE - Amman, Jordan.
item.description: This position was advertised as a Senior Adviser, Education (Education in Emergencies), P-5, within UNICEF’s Global Programme Division (GPD), based in Amman, Jordan. The role provides strategic leadership, policy advice, and technical stewardship for UNICEF’s global Education in Emergencies portfolio, supporting preparedness, response, recovery, and resilient education systems across humanitarian and crisis-affected contexts. The incumbent works closely with Country Offices, Regional Offices, Centres of Excellence, governments, donors, and global partners to advance equitable access to quality education for children affected by conflict, displacement, and climate-related shocks. The position also leads global partnerships, knowledge generation, policy influence, resource mobilization, and inter-agency coordination to strengthen UNICEF’s education response and ensure continuity of learning during emergencies.

item.title: Readvertisement - Supply & Logistics Specialist, P-3, FT, #134030, Harare, Zimbabwe - ESAR
item.description: The Supply and Logistics Specialist reports to the Deputy Representative Operations as per the Country Office (CO) set-up and is responsible for managing the supply chains of a small sized country office, and/or small sized emergency response operation, or elements of the supply chains of a larger supply operation. The supply chain operations include planning, procurement, contracting, customs clearance, warehousing, in country transport and distribution, as well as monitoring of supplies, services and construction works.

item.title: Partnerships Manager (Lead for Frontier Data Tech) (P-4), TA, 364 days, #138364, DID, Valencia - Spain (Fully remote)
item.description: UNICEF is seeking a Programme and Partnership Lead/Specialist (Frontier Data Tech) to facilitate and foster our internal/external public/private sector AI and frontier data technologies relationships and projects, so that our network can most efficiently deliver impact.It is a bridging role between technology and social impact. This role involves coordinating stakeholders across UNICEF business units, country, regional offices, managing discussions with corporate partners, and sifting manifold opportunities into specific deliverables that advance the AI Office and the Frontier Data work in-house and with our research partners. The successful candidate combines digital product development and community of practice experience over a child-centered mission. Working under the general direction of the Chief AI Officer and the data scientist specialist, the Programme and Partnership Lead/Specialist will contribute to the goals of AI for programs, Child Centred AI (Advocacy) and Strategy workstreams within the AI Office.This role emphasizes coordinating strategic partnerships for the AI Office, supporting the design and implementation of AI Office flagship initiatives using FDN model/approach, supporting community building activities and facilitating data sharing agreements with companies and global platforms.

item.title: Chief Education, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kenya Country Office, Nairobi #00013120
item.description: Under the overall guidance of the Deputy Representative, the Chief is responsible for managing and supervising all stages of education programmes/projects. This includes strategic planning and formulation, as well as delivery of results on strengthening national education systems to improve learning outcomes, access to quality, equitable and inclusive pre-primary, primary secondary education and TVET, especially for children and young people who are marginalized, disadvantaged and excluded in society. Incumbent leads a group of professional and support staff to develop and manage the education programme in the country.The Chief is responsible for establishing the plans of action and overseeing work progress to ensure the achievement of concrete and sustainable programme/project results,

item.title: Chief Child Protection (P-4), FT, #42310, Türkiye, Ankara - ECAR
item.description: If you are a committed, creative professional and are passionate about making a lasting difference for children, the world's leading children's rights organization would like to hear from you.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist, (P-3), FT, #137764 Gaza, State of Palestine, MENA
item.description: Social and Behaviour Change in UNICEF is a cross-cutting programme strategy that addresses the cognitive, social and structural determinants of social change in both development and humanitarian contexts. SBC uses the latest in social and behavioral sciences to understand people, their beliefs, values, and the socio-cultural norms that shape their lives, with the aim of engaging them and increasing their influence in the design of solutions for sustainable behavior and social change. SBC is at the core of UNICEF’s mandate, with corporate results across sectors revolving around social and behavioral practices like immunization, breastfeeding, hygiene, and positive discipline.

item.title: Partnerships Manager (Foundations), P-4, Fixed Term Position, Rome, Italy Private Fund Raising and Partnerships, #00121602

item.title: Finance Specialist (Supply Financing), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Copenhagen, Supply Division #00116964
item.description: The Supply Financing Specialist will be based at UNICEF Supply Division, and will support the implementation of the UNICEF Supply Division’s Financing Partnerships and Solutions Strategy (which focuses on supporting governments’ mobilization of domestic resources to buy essential supplies while “bridging” timing gaps in government or grant disbursements of Ministries of Health and Finance, development partners, as well as to build new financing opportunities, partnerships and solutions to support the provision of essential supplies and accelerate results for children) related to supply financing activities with respect to other programmes / challenges, especially resource mobilization by national budgets, market dynamics, accessing financing instruments, such as the Vaccine Independence Initiative (“VII”) revolving fund.

item.title: Chief Child Protection, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Antananarivo, Madagascar, #00022810
item.description: Join UNICEF Madagascar as Chief, Child Protection (P-4), a strategic leadership role offering the opportunity to drive UNICEF’s efforts to strengthen child protection systems, prevent and respond to violence against children, and support the delivery of quality protection services. item.title: Supply & Logistics Manager, (P-4), FT, #020069, Bamako, Mali, WCAR
item.description: We are looking for a strategic, collaborative and solutions-oriented Supply and Logistics leader who demonstrates UNICEF’s core values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust, Accountability and Sustainability, and who can manage ambiguity, build partnerships, innovate, think and act strategically, and drive impactful results for children. Your leadership will directly enable UNICEF Mali to deliver essential goods, services and construction works where they are needed most. By strengthening supply chain performance, risk management and partner capacity, you will help protect UNICEF’s credibility as a trusted steward of resources and a reliable partner for children in complex humanitarian settings.If you are motivated by operational problem-solving, field-oriented delivery and the opportunity to help UNICEF reach children in some of the hardest-to-access areas, this role offers a meaningful platform to make a measurable difference
